quests.instruction: A boy keeps making fun of Ali's new glasses just to see him upset. Which verb describes this unkind action?
quests.hint: It hurts someone's feelings while pretending to be funny.
quests.explanation: Tease means to make fun of someone in an unkind way. Gentle teasing between friends can still hurt.
quests.funFact: If a joke makes someone sad, it is not a good joke.

quests.instruction: A big dog runs toward a toddler, and Mum steps in front of her to keep her safe. What does Mum do?
quests.hint: She keeps someone from harm.
quests.explanation: Protect means to keep someone or something safe from harm.
quests.funFact: Helmets protect your head, and sunscreen protects your skin.

quests.instruction: A kitten is stuck high in a tree, and a firefighter climbs up and brings it down safely. Which action word is being shown?
quests.hint: The kitten was in danger, and he saved it.
quests.explanation: Rescue means to save someone from danger or trouble.
quests.funFact: Rescue dogs can find people trapped under snow or fallen buildings.

quests.instruction: On her birthday, Hana walks in and finds all her friends hiding with a cake. They shout, 'Happy birthday!' What did they do?
quests.hint: She did not expect it at all.
quests.explanation: Surprise means to do something that a person does not expect.
quests.funFact: A surprise party works only when everybody keeps the secret.

quests.instruction: Ravi jumps out from behind the door, and his little brother gets a fright. Choose the best verb.
quests.hint: His brother feels sudden fear.
quests.explanation: Scare means to make someone feel frightened.
quests.funFact: Cats puff up their fur to scare other animals and look bigger.

quests.instruction: Sara breathes slowly and tells her nervous friend, 'Everything will be fine.' What does Sara do?
quests.hint: She helps her friend feel more peaceful.
quests.explanation: Calm means to make someone feel quiet and peaceful, or to become peaceful yourself.
quests.funFact: Slow breaths tell your body that you are safe.

quests.instruction: Zoe sees a classmate's beautiful painting and thinks, 'I wish I could do that.' She looks up to her. Which verb matches what happens?
quests.hint: She feels respect for someone's skill.
quests.explanation: Admire means to look at someone or something with respect and pleasure.
quests.funFact: You can admire a person's kindness as well as their talent.

quests.instruction: Noor's science model is so clever that the visitors stop and stare. Her work ___ them.
quests.hint: They think it is excellent.
quests.explanation: Impress means to make people think very well of you or your work.
quests.funFact: Impress is often followed by 'with': She impressed everyone with her story.

quests.instruction: Leo says again and again, 'I am the fastest in the school, and nobody can beat me.' What does Leo do?
quests.hint: He talks too proudly about himself.
quests.explanation: Boast means to talk about yourself in a proud way to impress others.
quests.funFact: Humble people let their actions speak for them.

quests.instruction: Max tells the teacher that the room is too hot, the chairs are hard and the pens are bad. Which verb fits the scene?
quests.hint: He says that he is unhappy about things.
quests.explanation: Complain means to say that you are not happy about something.
quests.funFact: A polite complaint explains the problem and suggests a fix.

quests.instruction: After the plant falls, Tom says, 'It was me. I knocked it over.' What does Tom do?
quests.hint: He tells the truth about what he did.
quests.explanation: Admit means to say that something is true, especially when it is not easy to say.
quests.funFact: Admitting a mistake is the first step to fixing it.

quests.instruction: Dev is offered a sweet but says, 'No, thank you, I have just brushed my teeth.' Choose the action word that matches.
quests.hint: He says no politely.
quests.explanation: Refuse means to say no to something that is offered or asked for.
quests.funFact: Saying 'no, thank you' is a polite way to refuse.

quests.instruction: Mia gets a present from a friend and says, 'Thank you, I love it!' What does she do with the gift?
quests.hint: She takes what is given gladly.
quests.explanation: Accept means to take something that is offered to you.
quests.funFact: Accept can also mean to agree that something is true: I accept that I was wrong.

quests.instruction: Anu asks, 'May I go outside?' and her mother says yes. Her mother lets her go. What does her mother do?
quests.hint: Her mother gives her permission.
quests.explanation: Allow means to let someone do something.
quests.funFact: In some libraries, people are not allowed to eat or drink.

quests.instruction: A sign at the pool says, 'No running.' This means that running is not permitted. Which verb describes the action?
quests.hint: It says that you must not do something.
quests.explanation: Forbid means to say that someone must not do something.
quests.funFact: Forbid is a stronger word than 'ask not to'.

quests.instruction: On a dark night, Kofi looks at a shooting star and hopes that his dream will come true. What does he do?
quests.hint: He hopes for something he really wants.
quests.explanation: Wish means to want something that may be hard to get or may not happen.
quests.funFact: People in many cultures make a wish when they blow out birthday candles.

quests.instruction: While Sam sleeps, he sees a story with flying horses in his head. Which action word is being shown?
quests.hint: It happens when his eyes are closed.
quests.explanation: Dream means to see pictures and stories in your mind while you sleep. You can also dream about what you want to do one day.
quests.funFact: Most people have several dreams every night, but forget most of them.

quests.instruction: The children put on capes and say, 'I am a king, and you are my guard.' What are they doing?
quests.hint: They act as if something is true during a game.
quests.explanation: Pretend means to act as if something is true when it is not, usually in play.
quests.funFact: Pretend play helps young children learn about the world.

quests.instruction: After a hard school day, Ben lies on the sofa with his favourite book and does nothing busy. Choose the best verb.
quests.hint: He lets his body and mind slow down.
quests.explanation: Relax means to rest and feel calm and free of worry.
quests.funFact: Even a few minutes of quiet can help you relax.

quests.instruction: The marathon runner sits down at the end of the race and breathes quietly for a while. What does she do?
quests.hint: She stops activity to get her strength back.
quests.explanation: Rest means to stop work or activity so your body can get strength back.
quests.funFact: Muscles grow stronger during rest, not just during exercise.

quests.instruction: After a cold, Rina is feeling stronger every day and will soon be back at school. She will ___.
quests.hint: She is getting well again.
quests.explanation: Recover means to become well or strong again after being ill or hurt.
quests.funFact: 'Recover' can also mean to get back something that was lost.

quests.instruction: The baby keeps pulling Dad's hair, even after Dad says 'stop.' She is starting to ___ him.
quests.hint: It makes him slightly angry.
quests.explanation: Annoy means to make someone a little angry by doing something again and again.
quests.funFact: A buzzing mosquito can annoy everyone in the room.

quests.instruction: Priya's brother lightly moves his fingers along her side, and she cannot stop laughing. Which verb matches what happens?
quests.hint: It makes her laugh without any joke.
quests.explanation: Tickle means to touch someone lightly so that they laugh or feel a funny feeling.
quests.funFact: People cannot easily tickle themselves because the brain expects the touch.

quests.instruction: Nobody can stop Hana when she hears a funny joke. She starts to make little laughing sounds. What does she do?
quests.hint: Her laugh is quiet and high.
quests.explanation: Giggle means to laugh in a light and silly way.
quests.funFact: 'Giggle' is one of many English words whose sound is like its meaning.

quests.instruction: Mia falls and cuts her knee. It starts to feel painful. Which verb fits the scene?
quests.hint: It gives her a feeling of pain.
quests.explanation: Hurt means to feel pain, or to cause pain to somebody.
quests.funFact: 'Hurt' keeps the same form in the present and past.

quests.instruction: With a clean bandage and some rest, the cut on Mia's knee slowly becomes whole again. What does it do?
quests.hint: The skin makes itself new.
quests.explanation: Heal means to become healthy again after an injury.
quests.funFact: Your skin can heal itself because it makes new cells all the time.

quests.instruction: The nurse wraps a soft cloth around Tom's sprained wrist to support it. Choose the action word that matches.
quests.hint: She covers an injury with a cloth.
quests.explanation: Bandage means to cover an injured part of the body with a strip of cloth. 'Bandage' is a noun and a verb.
quests.funFact: Bandages were once made from simple strips of linen.

quests.instruction: At the animal shelter, the children give some of their time to look after the puppies, and nobody pays them. What do they do?
quests.hint: They do something helpful because they choose to.
quests.explanation: Volunteer means to offer to do something helpful without being paid.
quests.funFact: Many communities depend on volunteers to run libraries and clubs.

quests.instruction: Raj gives his old books to a school that needs them. Which verb describes the action?
quests.hint: He gives something freely to help others.
quests.explanation: Donate means to give something to people or a group that needs it.
quests.funFact: Blood banks depend on adults who donate blood.

quests.instruction: There is one swing and two children. Each child uses it for a short time, then lets the other have a go. What do they do?
quests.hint: They use it one after another.
quests.explanation: Take turns means to do something one after another, so everyone gets a chance.
quests.funFact: Taking turns is a basic rule of nearly every game.
